occurrence_sentence: Rydberg Technologies Inc., a global leader in Rydberg quantum technologies and a pioneer in radio frequency (RF) quantum sensing, today announced its low size weight and power (SWaP) atomic receiver and the successful demonstration of the world's first long-range radio communications with an atomic quantum sensor at the U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) C5ISR Center Network Modernization Experiment 2023 (NetModX23) event, a proving ground for next-generation technologies for communications and intelligence.
